name: Universe API
tagline: Ticketmaster-owned event creation and ticketing API for independent organizers
description: Universe provides an API for independent event organizers to create events, manage tickets, and access attendee data. Owned by Ticketmaster, it focuses on self-service event management for small to mid-size organizers.

auth.details: OAuth 2.0 access tokens; application registration required via developer portal

use_cases: fetch attendee lists for an event
